data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet with exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames, using the provided guide image only for cell placement, spacing, and centering. Do not include any guide lines, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or other overlays in the final art. The entire sheet background must be solid #FF00FF, with the magical effect occupying only the central area of each cell and nothing crossing cell edges. Keep the effect contained within the central 65% of each cell, centered consistently and at the same scale across all four frames. 

Frame 1 (top-left): a faint circular golden rune glyph ignites, subtle and elegant, with soft glowing arc segments and a magical embossed look.
Frame 2 (top-right): the rune ring flashes bright white-gold with small teal accents, higher intensity, crisp luminous rune energy.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): the rune circle breaks into a compact explosive burst with triangular light fragments and concentrated magical shards, dynamic but contained.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): fading glyph fragments and soft golden sparks, diminishing glow, wispy remnants of the rune.

Style: clean HD fantasy card-game effect, high contrast, readable at small card size, polished VFX sprite sheet, no playing card, no UI, no text, no readable letters, no icons, no characters, no environment. Ensure each frame is distinct yet visually consistent in scale and composition. Background outside the FX is solid magenta #FF00FF everywhere.
